activity_summary: Mistress Ansell came up with a dish and said you had been walking before the house was up. She asked if it was the lovers. You said no. She did not ask again. The loaf was still a thumb short of the notch, and still a penny. You did not tell her what the morning's pages were.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said no, and did not tell the plot.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Brought the dish, asked once, and took the no.

facets.activity: Ate, and told Mistress Ansell it was not the lovers

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch, and it is still a penny.
